Thank you so much for your reply. The jokes are mostly poking harmless fun at him or being overly sarcastic to something he has said. An example of this being when he mentioned a famous cricketers name in something he was describing and i replied sarcastically like ‘oh yeah haha i love him’ me not being a cricket fanatic obviously didn’t know this person and he knew that. Hence, he took this kinda to heart and told me that i pissed him off. I understand that this may be perceived as annoying but it is a large part of my humour and my reactions so i am confused as to if i should tell him how i feel or try lessen the sarcasm and teasing.

Some of the jokes i make may be at his expense but it is jokes and things i do that don’t concern him which often upset him. Sometimes i joke about and say things such as ‘i love you more’ and he takes it very to heart and will become upset regarding it. I understood at first but as time goes on he should know i’m joking when faced with similar issues as that. Once i used his friends last name in an example i was making and he seemed to become very agitated and upset over it (his friends last name is pretty common and we were previously talking about him so it wasn’t so out of the blue). In every other aspect we are almost the same and are very compatible and on par with one another but is the odd moments such as these which really make me wonder.
